prompt:
A cinematic storyboard sheet for a Sri Lankan television drama: 9 photorealistic film stills of ONE scene, laid out in a grid 3 panels across and 3 down, read left to right, then top to bottom. Every panel is a tall portrait 9:16 still of the same size, separated by thin, even, plain white gutters. All panels are the same scene's world, painted together: the same people, props, light and colour grade in every panel. The weather and the ground (dry or wet, rain falling or not) are as each panel says: they can change during the scene, and a panel that says it is dry has no rain and no wet ground.

Reference images, in order: image 1 is the location plate for Colombo roadside; image 2 is the reference sheet for phone. Take from image 1: the kind of place: its ground, water, plants, structures and materials. It is ONE view of the place; each panel has its own camera position, so do not repeat this view in every panel; image 2: phone exactly as shown.

People (every panel): every person is a smooth, matte, faceless artist's mannequin in one solid colour, with jointed limbs and simple hands: Kasun is the red mannequin; Anudi is the blue mannequin. A small raised ridge on the front of the head, where a nose would be, shows which way the head faces. Each mannequin has the person's real height and build and sits, stands and holds things exactly as a real person would. No faces, no hair, no clothes, no skin: only the mannequin colour. Everything else (the place, the props, the light, the weather) is a real, photorealistic film still.

World (every panel): Paint one unified storyboard image in a four-column, four-row grid, reading left to right and top to bottom. Fill the first fourteen cells and leave the final two cells blank, with plain gutters and no lettering, numbering or arrows anywhere. Use only their poses to convey attention. Render the setting and props realistically: Anudi's orange smartphone has a transparent case matching the reference, her navy folding umbrella is open, and her tan structured handbag has brass-coloured fittings. Throughout the conversation her left hand holds the umbrella shaft at waist height, with the handbag suspended from her left shoulder; her right hand receives and retains the phone. Soft early-morning overcast daylight comes from the road at camera right, balanced around 5600K, with warm naturalistic colour, muted greens and earth tones, and subdued amber shop practicals. The pavement and patched asphalt are wet, with shallow reflections and no falling rain throughout. Keep the business slightly darker than the foreground.

Geography: The narrow concrete pavement forms a continuous left-to-right path between the road in the foreground and weathered commercial frontages behind it. A small, muted leaf-green food three-wheeler occupies the vending bay at the left end, with an open serving hatch, metal counter and shelter canopy. Immediately right of the bay is the conversation position: Kasun stands on its left, Anudi on its right. A pale-green building pier and weathered concrete boundary wall continue behind Anudi toward the open pavement at screen right, her departure direction. The kerb drain follows the pavement across the foreground; utility poles and cables belong to the same connected frontage. All cameras stay on the road-facing side of the conversational axis. Wider views show the business at frame left and the pale-green pier at frame right; tighter views preserve those sides without forcing distant landmarks into their crops.

PANEL 1 (row 1, column 1) — Standing eye height on the road-facing side, looking across the pavement toward the frontage; 40mm, waist-up two-shot, medium depth of field. Background: The food three-wheeler and serving hatch stand behind the red mannequin at frame left. The pale-green pier and concrete wall are behind the blue mannequin at frame right; open pavement continues beyond the right edge. The red mannequin stands frame left with chest facing right and head inclined toward the handset between them. Its right arm reaches from the far side of its body toward frame centre, supporting the orange phone above the blue mannequin's open right palm; its left hand hangs at its near hip. The blue mannequin stands frame right with chest facing left and head angled down toward the exchange, its receiving right hand on the camera-near side. Its far left hand grips the umbrella shaft at the lower-right edge of its torso, with the handbag partly hidden over its far hip and the open canopy above.
PANEL 2 (row 1, column 2) — Standing eye height from a closer road-facing position; 50mm, chest-up two-shot, medium depth of field. Background: The recognizable serving hatch remains frame left behind the red mannequin. The pale-green pier remains frame right behind the blue mannequin, with the umbrella shaft rising along that side. The red mannequin occupies frame left, chest facing right and head turned toward the blue mannequin in a readable three-quarter orientation. The blue mannequin occupies frame right, chest facing left and head directed toward its partner, not toward the camera. The red mannequin's empty hands and the blue mannequin's right hand holding the phone at waist height are below the crop; its left hand also remains below the crop around the umbrella shaft. The handbag strap crosses its far shoulder at the right edge of its silhouette, beneath the cropped canopy.
PANEL 3 (row 1, column 3) — Standing eye height from the original road-facing master position; 40mm, waist-up two-shot, medium depth of field. Background: The three-wheeler, metal serving counter and canopy are recognizable at frame left behind the red mannequin. The pale-green pier and weathered wall remain frame right. The red mannequin stands left with chest and head facing right toward the blue mannequin, both empty hands resting at its sides. The blue mannequin stands right with chest facing left and head directed toward its partner in three-quarter profile. Its right hand holds the orange phone at waist height on the camera-near side, screen angled toward its body rather than the viewer. Its far left hand holds the umbrella shaft beside the frame-right edge of its torso, with the handbag hanging partly concealed over the far hip.
PANEL 4 (row 2, column 1) — Standing eye height from the same closer road-facing setup as shot 2; 50mm, chest-up two-shot, medium depth of field. Background: The serving hatch stays frame left, behind the red mannequin. The pale-green pier stays frame right, with the dark umbrella shaft against it. The red mannequin stands on the left with chest facing right and head directed toward its partner. The blue mannequin stands on the right with chest facing left and head held level toward the red mannequin. Both red hands remain below the crop; the blue right hand retains the phone at waist height below the crop, while its left hand holds the umbrella shaft below frame. The far-side handbag strap is visible at the blue mannequin's frame-right shoulder, and a narrow canopy edge enters above it.
PANEL 5 (row 2, column 2) — Standing eye height on the road-facing side; 65mm, close chest-up two-shot, both heads equally sharp. Background: A softly blurred portion of the food hatch remains at frame left. The pale-green pier remains at frame right, without any visible phone display. The red mannequin fills the left half with chest facing right and head turned three-quarter toward the blue mannequin. The blue mannequin fills the right half with chest facing left and head directed toward the red mannequin. Their hands remain below the crop: the red hands are empty, the blue right hand retains the phone, and its left hand grips the umbrella shaft. The shaft and far-shoulder handbag strap remain at the right side of the blue silhouette.
PANEL 6 (row 2, column 3) — Road-facing side, slightly above waist height and angled down toward Anudi's right hand; 85mm insert, shallow depth of field. Background: Soft concrete pavement occupies the upper-right background and dark wet asphalt lies toward the lower-left, separated by the kerb. The food business remains outside the upper-left crop; no frontage is forced into this downward view. The blue mannequin's right hand and smartphone fill the panel, its forearm entering from frame right and the phone centred with its screen facing mostly upward. The fingers curl lightly around the transparent case, while the thumb rests beside the screen without pressing it. The illuminated screen shows an incoming-call layout with a generic avatar and coloured controls, but no written characters or photograph. A narrow orange case edge remains visible around the display; no other body part enters the frame.
PANEL 7 (row 3, column 1) — Standing eye height, southwest of Anudi on Kasun's side while remaining road-facing; 65mm, chest-up medium close-up, shallow depth of field. Background: The pale-green pier is soft at frame right, with a darker frontage blur toward frame left. The food three-wheeler remains farther left outside the crop. The blue mannequin stands toward frame right with chest facing screen left and head angled down-left toward the phone, never square to the camera. Its right hand holds the phone at chest height on the camera-near side, slightly left of the torso, with the screen tilted toward its head. Its left hand remains below the crop holding the umbrella shaft, which rises behind the frame-right edge of its body. The handbag strap rests on its far shoulder, and the handset is not yet at its ear.
PANEL 8 (row 3, column 2) — Standing eye height from a more frontal road-facing position than shot 7, retaining a three-quarter view; 75mm, chest-up medium close-up, shallow depth of field. Background: The pale-green pier remains frame right and the darker shuttered frontage remains frame left in soft blur. The business stays outside the left edge; the remote caller is not pictured. The blue mannequin stands frame right with chest facing left and head turned left in three-quarter view, clear of a direct camera-facing position. Its right hand holds the smartphone against the camera-near side of its head, along the head's frame-right edge, with the elbow bent below. Its left hand remains below frame around the umbrella shaft, visible along the body's far, frame-right side. The handbag strap remains on that far shoulder.
PANEL 9 (row 3, column 3) — Standing eye height from Kasun's road-facing side, matching the side of shot 7; 85mm close-up, the mannequin's head filling the panel, shallow depth of field. Background: A narrow pale-green blur remains at frame right, with darker frontage blur at frame left. The three-wheeler stays offscreen left; the umbrella shaft is confined to the far-right edge if it enters the crop. The blue mannequin's head fills the panel in a leftward three-quarter orientation, with the upper chest still aligned screen left. Its right hand cups the orange phone against the camera-near side of its head, placing the phone along the frame-right contour. The left hand and handbag are outside the close crop, with the left hand still occupied by the umbrella below frame.

Bodies (every panel): each person sits or stands the way a real person does the task in front of them, never posed for the camera. The body faces the task and only the head turns: someone at a steering wheel sits squarely behind it, the wheel centred in front of the chest, back against the seat, both hands on the rim; someone at a desk sits square to it; someone at a stove faces the stove. A camera beside a person sees the body side-on, not the chest. Nobody looks into or faces the lens unless the panel says so. Head and eyes turn together: the eyes never roll hard to one side while the face points at the camera; a near-frontal face looks just past the lens.

Draw NO text of any kind: no panel numbers, no captions, no titles, no timestamps, no arrows, no labels, no borders other than the gutters. The people, place and everyday details are Sri Lankan.
